lede: North Texas carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.5 against +0.1, a 3.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Tulsa +10.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with North Texas winning 77% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is qb room, where North Texas leads Tulsa by 99 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 78% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
